differences.a_observable: The gaps between the keyboard keys are tight, thin grey lines.
differences.b_observable: The gaps between the keyboard keys are wider and more pronounced, creating thicker dark lines.
differences.fix: Decrease the gap width between the keys to match the tighter layout of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The white keys exhibit a soft blue-grey color cast in the shadows and a noticeable vignette towards the corners.
differences.b_observable: The white keys are flatly lit with neutral grey shadows and lack a vignette.
differences.fix: Add a subtle blue color cast to the ambient light and introduce a vignette to darken the corners.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly card shows a subtle specular highlight and glossy reflection as the camera pans.
differences.b_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a completely flat, matte texture with no specular reflections.
differences.fix: Increase the glossiness and specular intensity of the yellow card material.
